Topic 11.2: Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
3. Practise Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 11.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA MATINI YA KUJICHAGULIA
This lesson teaches Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia for Grade 7 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia above.
2. Explain Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia
